segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the revised package for Northlake: 42 seats, the analytics add-on, and the standard onboarding services for the May 20 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That lines up. The only thing I want to confirm is whether those 42 seats include our three warehouse supervisors, or if we need to add them later.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They’re included in the 42. If you add more after launch, the same per-seat rate applies and it just prorates on the next invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the number you sent yesterday was $38,640 for the year, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, $38,640 annually, net 30 billing, one-year term starting May 1. Onboarding is a separate $4,200 one-time line item.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. Our finance team asked if the invoice can reference PO 7716 and split the subscription and onboarding into separate lines.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that’s standard. I’ll make sure the order form and invoice show PO 7716 and break those out clearly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For implementation, we’ve got their availability on May 6 and May 13 for training. Is that enough?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so two 90-minute sessions should be fine for your group. We’ll schedule admin training on May 6 and end-user training on May 13, both at 11 a.m. Central.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Works for us. Send the order form today and I’ll route it for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have it this afternoon, and once it’s signed we’ll confirm the kickoff agenda and the training invites.
